_comment: Passive skills (V, 2026-10-02): a skill that is not chosen, it triggers by itself in battle, or is built into the character. Triggers: battle_start (when the fight or the wave begins), on_damaged (when the holder is hit, with `chance` %), hp_below (once, when the holder falls under `threshold` of its HP). The effects are the buffs and debuffs of the skills. A species gets the passive of its family if any, else the one of its role (food monsters and fodder below `min_stars` have none). PLACEHOLDER numbers.
